title: WPMS/273/2015 of Deobhoomi Sabji Fal Aarti Association Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 273 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chauhan, Deputy Advocate General for
State of Uttarakhand / respondent no. 1.
Mr. J.C. Belwal, Advocate for respondent nos. 2
to 4.
Undisputedly, Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti is
authorized to raise construction of shops within the
Mandi area; Mandi Samiti is only authorized body
to select the spot for raising construction of shops to
be allotted to the vegetables, fruits and grains
vendors.
The only grievance of the members of petitioner
association is that earlier members of the petitioner
association were allotted shops in old block at very
high premium and rent; after allotment, so made,
Mandi Samiti is now raising constructions prior to
the shops of the petitioner association; if such new
block is permitted to be constructed, customers may
visit new block and may not visit present block
wherein members of petitioner association are
having shops, therefore, business of the members of
the petitioner association shall be affected
adversely.
Merely because by raising new block customers
may visit only new block is no ground to stop
Mandi Samiti to raise constructions. Moreover,
where new block has to be constructed is the policy
matter of the Mandi Samiti wherein no interference
seems to be necessary while exercising jurisdiction
under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.
It is reported by Mr. J.C. Belwal, Advocate, for
the Mandi Samiti that construction has already been
commenced and at this stage, shifting of new block
is not desirable.
For the reasons mentioned hereinbefore, writ
petition fails and is hereby dismissed in limine.
CLMA No. 1199 of 2015 also stands disposed
of accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 23.02.2015 SKS
